title: 第六章 果然不能随便立FLAG
slug: 次元法典全本免费-次元法典最新章节列表
content_zh:
如果是之前的话，那么看见和游戏之中一样的这一幕，方正也只会撇了撇嘴不会太过放在心上。但是在亲身体验了这些活死人的难缠之后，方正终于对奈非天这种变态的存在有了一丝直观的感受。
就算方正击败这些活死人，也完全是依靠十字军打击的圣光之力。但是这奈非天可完全就是靠自己的力量啊，一锤子下去那些倒霉的活死人运气差点儿那就是个尸骨无存，运气好的也直接被放飞自我了。看的方正啧啧称奇，这会儿他总算是对奈非天的力量有一个直接的了解了。
等等………我在这看戏干嘛？我他喵的还有任务呢！
在看着眼前的圣教军又一次扫飞了那些活死人之后，方正顿时一愣，这才想起自己来这里可不是看热闹的啊！
霜之哀伤可还饿着呢！
想到这里，方正也是毫不犹豫，握紧手中的武器冲了上去。
相对于游戏之中的“教学关卡”来说，方正等人所遇到的活死人数量显然更多，除了第一波从地下爬出来的活死人之外，后面又陆续出现了好几波活死人的袭击。他们的数量越来越多，以至于方正和圣教军妹子联手都有些抵挡不住了，而民兵那边更是死伤惨重，除了拉姆福德队长还在努力支撑之外，其他几个民兵不是死了，就是带了伤，眼看也是活不久了。
这情况不对啊！
再次砍翻一个活死人，方正也是喘了口气，他抬头向着四周望去，只看见除了崔斯特姆小镇大门口的火光之外，四周都被笼罩在一片黑暗之中。耳边只能够听见那些活死人的低吼，以及不时闪耀过的光辉。
“哈啊………哈啊………这该死的………也太多了点儿吧。”
握着手中的霜之哀伤，盯着从黑暗中摇摇摆摆走出来的活死人，方正也是不住的喘息起来。他都记不得自己消灭了多少活死人，只记得自己砍倒一个，就从旁边冒出来两个。砍倒两个，又冒出来四个。简直就是源源不断，似乎怎么杀都杀不完一样。
这才是真正的暗黑世界吗………？
直到这个时候，方正才感觉到了一丝恐惧，玩游戏的时候，他唯一的感觉就是刷刷刷的都要烦死了。要说的话最多也就是有点儿疑问，为什么暗黑的世界里人类会如此悲催。但是现在，方正终于明白了，游戏与现实是不一样的。
暗黑世界之中的人类，之所以被逼到差点儿灭绝的地步，也是有原因的。
“喝啊———！”
看着摇摇晃晃朝着自己扑来的活死人，方正握紧霜之哀伤，怒吼一声向前砍去，伴随着圣光一闪，那个活死人顿时从腰间一分为二，跌落在地。但让方正没有想到的是，就在这个活死人倒地的瞬间，它的上半身猛然一跳，接着两只手迅速在地面上爬行着向自己抓了过来！
“靠！！”
看见这忽如其来的一幕，方正也是吓了一跳。他几乎是本能的举起霜之哀伤，用力向下一刺。锋利的剑刃“唰”的贯穿了那个活死人的身体，随后就看见道道灵魂的雾气从活死人身上浮现，然后被吸入到霜之哀伤的剑身之中。接着那不住颤抖的活死人残躯这才像是失去了能源供应一般没有了动静。
“235………”
看了一眼眼前系统提示的灵魂之力数值，方正喘了口气。这种刷刷刷虽然不是他希望的，但不管怎么说，霜之哀伤吸取灵魂的任务现在看起来倒是有了完成的可能。暗黑世界里别的什么都缺，就是不缺怪物。而方正相信，霜之哀伤一定也非常喜欢这些邪恶的灵魂。

“呜呃—————！！”
而就在与此同时，忽然在远处的密林之中，传来了一阵诡异的声音。那听起来像是女人的哭喊，又像是喝醉的人呕吐的声音。而听见这个声音，拉姆福德与圣教军妹子的脸色瞬间变了。
“我说这些该死的玩意儿为什么怎么杀都杀不完！”
这会儿方正也反应了过来，尸母是王后侍女所转化而成的怪物，这种怪物最大的特点就是她会制造更多的活死人。究竟是什么原理方正也搞不清楚，不过他知道尸母制造活死人的过程就是呕吐，然后那些活死人就会从那一滩里爬出来………呜，光是想都让人觉得反胃。

content_en:
If it had been before, then when Fang Zheng saw this scene that was the same as in the game, he would just curl his lips and not take it too seriously. But after personally experiencing the difficulties of these living dead, Fang Zheng finally had an intuitive feeling for the perverted existence of Nephalem.
Even if Founder defeated these living dead, he would only rely on the power of the Holy Light struck by the Crusaders. But this Nephalem relies entirely on his own strength. With one blow, those unlucky living dead who are almost unlucky will be wiped out, and those who are lucky will be released directly. Fang Zheng was amazed when he saw it. At this moment, he finally had a direct understanding of the power of the Nephalem.
Wait...why am I watching a show here? I still have a fucking mission!
After watching the Crusaders in front of him sweep away the living dead again, Fang Zheng was stunned for a moment, and then he remembered that he was not here to watch the fun!
Frostmourne is still hungry!
Thinking of this, Fang Zheng did not hesitate, clenched the weapon in his hand and rushed forward.
Compared with the "teaching level" in the game, the number of living dead encountered by Fang Zheng and others was obviously larger. In addition to the first wave of living dead crawling out of the ground, there were several waves of living dead attacks later. Their numbers were increasing, so much so that Fang Zheng and the Crusader girls were unable to resist the forces together, and the militiamen suffered heavy casualties. Except for Captain Rumford, who was still trying to support them, several other militiamen were either dead or injured, and it seemed that they would not live long.
This situation is wrong!
After cutting down a living dead again, Fang Zheng also took a breath. He raised his head and looked around, only to see that except for the fire at the gate of Tristram Town, the surroundings were shrouded in darkness. In his ears, he could only hear the low roars of the living dead, and the light that shone from time to time.
"Haah...haah...this is damn...too much."
Holding Frostmourne in his hand and staring at the living dead waddling out of the darkness, Fang Zheng couldn't help but gasp. He couldn't even remember how many living dead he had killed. He only remembered that after he chopped down one, two more appeared from the side. Cut down two, and four more pop up. There is simply a steady stream of them, as if they can’t be killed no matter how hard they are killed.
Is this the real dark world...?
It was only then that Fang Zheng felt a hint of fear. When playing the game, his only feeling was that he was getting bored to death. The most I can say is that I have some doubts about why humans are so miserable in the dark world. But now, Fang Zheng finally understood that games and reality are different.
There is a reason why humans in the dark world were driven to the point of almost extinction.
"Drink--!"
Looking at the living dead staggering toward him, Fang Zheng tightened his grip on Frostmourne and slashed forward with a roar. With a flash of holy light, the living dead was split into two from the waist and fell to the ground. But what Fang Zheng didn't expect was that the moment the living dead fell to the ground, its upper body jumped suddenly, and then its two hands quickly crawled on the ground to grab him!
"Fuck!!"
Fang Zheng was also startled when he saw this sudden scene. He almost instinctively raised Frostmourne and stabbed it hard. The sharp sword blade penetrated the body of the living dead with a "swish", and then saw the mist of the soul emerging from the living dead, and then being sucked into the sword body of Frostmourne. Then the trembling remains of the living dead became silent as if they had lost their energy supply.
"235......"
After taking a look at the soul power value displayed by the system in front of him, Fang Zheng took a breath. Although this kind of brushing was not what he expected, no matter what, Frostmourne's mission of absorbing soulsNow it seems that it is possible to complete it. There is nothing missing in the world of darkness except monsters. And Fang Zheng believed that Frostmourne must also like these evil souls very much.
“Uh-huh————!!”
At the same time, a strange sound suddenly came from the dense forest in the distance. It sounded like a woman crying or a drunk person vomiting. Upon hearing this voice, the expressions of Rumford and the Crusader girl changed instantly.
"I wonder why these damn things can't be killed no matter how hard they are killed!"
At this moment, Fang Zheng also realized that the Corpse Mother was a monster transformed from the queen's maid. The biggest feature of this monster was that she would create more living dead. Fang Zheng couldn't figure out what the principle was, but he knew that the process of creating the living dead was vomiting, and then the living dead would crawl out of the pool... Wow, just thinking about it makes people feel sick to their stomachs.
